# CANDIDATE: BOS_ALIGN_VWAP_ENTRY_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price makes a break of structure (higher high) on the 5‑min chart while the EMA ribbon is bullishly stacked and price is above VWAP, the move likely has institutional follow‑through. This setup captures early momentum rather than a re‑entry after a dip.

## Mechanism

Entry: On a 5‑min bar, if current high > prior 5‑min high (forming a BOS) AND close > VWAP AND EMA(8) > EMA(21) > EMA(55) (ribbon stacked up) THEN enter long at the close of that bar.  
Exit: Initial stop = low of the BOS bar (or prior swing low); target = 1.5× risk; runner trails 12% of ATR from highest high after entry.  
Regime filters: VIX < 20, entry after 10:00 ET (first 30 min avoided), avoid choppy sessions where EMA ribbon is flat or crossing.
